exposure: Mode of delivery (elective vs. emergency cesarean section)
outcome: Umbilical cord blood native thiol levels
Umbilical cord blood total thiol levels
cohort: 166 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section (83 elective and 83 emergency).
finding: Oxidative stress, as measured by thiol/disulfide balance, was increased in emergency cesarean section compared to elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was associated with increased oxidative stress in newborns compared to elective cesarean section, but there was no difference in neonatal Apgar scores between the groups.
